events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with product consultations, games, prizes, product trials, an immersive installation and a chance to meet founder Sarah Cheung.
events.what_is_free: Free entry plus a full-size SACHEU product for attendees while supplies last; games and prizes are also advertised. A separate gift-with-purchase requires a qualifying recent Ulta Beauty purchase.
events.caveats: Organizer fine print explicitly says RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance or a reserved place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Products, gifts and promotional items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20, 11 AM-5 PM daily. RSVP is useful for communications/planning but is not the admission mechanism; arrive early for capacity and giveaway availability.

events.event_name: Cafe Yaeji: Free Oatly Gochujang Lattes
events.what_it_is: Two-day Korean-dabang-inspired Cafe Yaeji pop-up created by Oatly and artist/producer Yaeji.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary iced Gochujang Lattes made with espresso, Oatly Barista Edition, gochujang-vanilla base, salted vanilla cold foam and gochugaru.
events.caveats: Current sources describe the cafe as free/open and do not establish an advance RSVP requirement. Complimentary drinks are inherently inventory-limited; do not imply guaranteed availability late in the day.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20, 9 AM-3 PM at 48 Ludlow St.

events.event_name: Coffee Project New York UES Opening Party
events.what_it_is: Upper East Side opening celebration for Coffee Project New York.
events.what_is_free: The brand advertises free coffee during the opening-party window.
events.caveats: The free-coffee offer is tied to the advertised 8-11 AM opening-party window. No advance RSVP requirement was established in the current sources.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 8-11 AM at Coffee Project New York UES, 1219 1st Ave.

events.what_it_is: One-day Kilian Paris pop-up celebrating the fragrance brand's cocktails collection.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples while supplies last. Exclusive gifts are tied to purchase.
events.caveats: Mocktails and samples are while supplies last. Gifts with purchase are not general freebies. Current listings describe the activation as open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 12-8 PM at 401 W 14th St in the Meatpacking District. A secondary listing displayed an incorrect east/west street direction; the corroborated Meatpacking address is 401 W 14th St.

events.address: Pier 17, 89 South Street, New York, NY 10038
events.what_it_is: Dunkin' sampling truck activation at Pier 17 serving seasonal drink samples and swag.
events.what_is_free: Free samples of Iced Pumpkin Latte, Berry Clementine Refresher and Strawberry Dragon Fruit Refresher, plus Dunkin' swag, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Samples and swag are while supplies last. Current listings describe the truck as open to the public and do not establish an RSVP requirement.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 2:30-6 PM at Pier 17 in the Seaport.
